title: staging swa publish workflow
objective: Implement GitHub Actions flow that builds Expo web and publishes to Azure staging-testnet with smoke validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow builds web artifact in CI.
Workflow deploys artifact to staging target only.
Post-deploy smoke checks fail fast on unhealthy routes.

title: contract init verification
objective: Harden testnet deployment script to verify Lockb0x initialization and fail deployment on inconsistent on-chain state.
acceptanceCriteria: Script enforces initialization checks.
Manifest captures initialization verification state.
Failure paths return non-zero exit codes.

title: relay service staging deploy
objective: Deploy relay service to staging infrastructure with health endpoint and integration verification from mobile local messaging flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Relay service has deployable target for staging.
Health endpoint is reachable from smoke checks.
Local messaging uses staging relay endpoint in staging profile.

title: solid auth release hardening
objective: Complete cross-platform Solid auth runtime checks and ensure profile/env coherence for web and native staging builds.
acceptanceCriteria: Web/native auth flow smoke passes.
Profile mismatch paths emit actionable errors.
Env profile constraints are validated in runtime startup.

title: staging smoke suite
objective: Create end-to-end smoke suite and manual UAT checklist for staging-testnet release gate.
acceptanceCriteria: Smoke script covers auth, feed, local messaging, and wallet registration.
Manual checklist is documented and executable by non-authors.
CI can run smoke suite against staging domain.

title: open-source community health files
objective: Create all GitHub Community Standards files (LICENSE, CONTRIBUTING.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, SECURITY.md, issue templates, PR template, CODEOWNERS) so the repo passes the GitHub Community Standards checklist before going public.
acceptanceCriteria: LICENSE, CONTRIBUTING.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, SECURITY.md present and non-empty.
Bug report and feature request issue templates present under .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/.
PR template present at .github/pull_request_template.md.
CODEOWNERS routes docs changes to DOCS_AGENT scope.
All GitHub Community Standards indicators confirmed green.

title: github wiki architecture and feature docs
objective: Author comprehensive GitHub Wiki covering all packages, architecture, getting-started guide, contributing workflow, security model, and project roadmap. Maintain _Sidebar.md for navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Wiki pages exist for every package in packages/ plus cross-cutting topics.
_Sidebar.md renders correct hierarchical navigation.
Every page cross-links to relevant source files and docs/ references.
Home page includes architecture diagram and quick links.

title: playwright walkthrough screenshots and video
objective: Use Playwright browser automation to validate all user journeys end-to-end, capturing screenshots and video walkthroughs. Embed visual evidence in Wiki pages and produce a docs/screenshots/README.md index.
acceptanceCriteria: Every user journey in staging-uat-checklist.md has at least one screenshot in docs/screenshots/.
Multi-step journeys have a video recording in docs/videos/.
docs/screenshots/README.md index lists all artifacts with journey cross-references.
Screenshots are embedded inline in the corresponding Wiki pages.
